司","evidence_issues":["source_kind_requires_content_classification","2025_effectiveness_requires_evidence"]},{"ref_id":"p073","text":"翰森制药对任何违反商业道德的行为持零容忍态度，搭建了最高至董事会的商业道德监察体系，并设置合规委员会作为合规事项的最高治理机构，通过不断完善政策与制度体系，增强公司防范和应对合规风险的能力，更好地应对不断变化的全球商业环境的挑战。我们依据法律法规、行业准则，构建起以风险管理为基础的合规管理体系。","section":"","pages":[],"source_period":"未说明","source_year":null,"source_title":"可持续发展","source_url":"https://cn.hspharm.com/ESG/compliance-management.htm","publisher":"翰森制药集团有限公司","evidence_issues":["source_kind_requires_content_classification","2025_effectiveness_requires_evidence"]},{"ref_id":"p074","text":"合规管理","section":"","pages":[],"source_period":"未说明","source_year":null,"source_title":"可持续发展","source_url":"https://cn.hspharm.com/ESG/compliance-management.htm","publisher":"翰森制药集团有限公司","evidence_issues":["source_kind_requires_content_classification","2025_effectiveness_requires_evidence"]}]}
